name: @vip/e2e
description: G-3.5 End-to-End Pipeline Validation: a deterministic, broker-free harness that wires the real events → rules → workflow → notify application spine onto one in-memory event bus and proves the whole backend chain (contracts, routing, tenant isolation, traceability, correlationId, replay, rule-conflict, dedup, performance) with no camera, no Mongo, no NATS. Lives under tools/ (outside the runtime dependency graph) so it may compose multiple services for validation.
